ai_summary: Afcons Infrastructure Limited reported a strong Q1 FY26, with a 6.4% increase in total income and significant profitability improvement marked by a 13% EBITDA margin (up 140 bps) and 50% PAT growth, reaffirming its positive full-year growth and order procurement guidance, including strategic entry into the European market. However, persistent payment delays in key projects, notably the UP Jal Jeevan Mission, are driving up working capital requirements and finance costs, while uncertainty regarding Tunnel Boring Machine (TBM) deployment for a critical High-Speed Rail project poses an ongoing operational challenge.
